lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}-kun,

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: are you busy?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: I'm wondering what I should prepare for the afternoon tea.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: What would you prefer?
You mean what kind of food I'd like?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Precisely.
Cookies would be nice.
Some cake would be nice.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: So you're a fan of cookies?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: I'll prepare some that will go well with the tea.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: So you have a soft spot for cakes?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: I'll prepare something I'm sure you'll enjoy
Wait, are you getting all this ready for me?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Who else?
Why?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Aren't you coming over today?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: I heard that you were.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: I intentionally kept my schedule open today

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: so that I could be here to greet you.
I don't know what you heard, but I wasn't intending on coming over today.
Sakura doesn't reply for a while.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Sorry for the late reply. I was just confirming something.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Turns out one of my subordinates made a mistake.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: I do have a guest coming today, but it's someone else, not you.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: I apologize on behalf of my subordinates for their error.
No worries. It's not a big deal.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: At least I have a better idea of what you enjoy eating.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: The next time you come visit me,

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: I'll prepare some refreshments that are perfectly suited to your tastes.
Thank you.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: You're welcome.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Have a nice day.
